title: Six pillars of an AI center of excellence
subtitle: One operating model that works for a single person, a team or an enterprise program.
alt: Six pillars around an AI center of excellence: strategy, governance, talent, technology, data and ethics, each with a one-line job.

replaces.legacySubject: Agentic Creator OS three-phase workflow, not the six-pillar CoE model

nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.detail: Define the work AI should handle, the work humans keep, and the outcomes worth measuring.

nodes.label: Governance
nodes.detail: Set rules for review, disclosure, privacy, source quality, and final human accountability.

nodes.label: Talent
nodes.detail: Build fluency through prompts, playbooks, role-specific workflows, and repeated practice.

nodes.label: Technology
nodes.detail: Choose the tool stack deliberately: models, agents, automations, interfaces, and observability.

nodes.label: Data
nodes.detail: Turn documents, notes, research, and outputs into reusable context with clear ownership.

nodes.label: Ethics
nodes.detail: Make values operational through checks, limits, review moments, and escalation paths.
